The provided docs show the pieces but not the complete global setup, so the code below is partly my own sketch.

The docs describe the global pattern for embeddings: "Settings.embed_model = OpenAIEmbedding()" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/embeddings.md]. You would assign a local model to that same object. The docs also say a fully-local stack uses "LLM: a local runtime such as llama.cpp, vLLM, Hugging Face Transformers, or Ollama." [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/privacy.md]

For Ollama, the docs show the constructor: "llm = Ollama(model="llama3.3", request_timeout=60.0, context_window=8000,)" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/understanding/using_llms.md]. The docs also give the package name for the Ollama integration: "llama-index-llms-ollama" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/models/llms/local.md]. The excerpt does not show the `Settings.llm` assignment or the exact Hugging Face import path, so the sketch below uses my own knowledge for those parts:

```python
from llama_index.core import Settings
from llama_index.llms.ollama import Ollama
from llama_index.embeddings.huggingface import HuggingFaceEmbedding

# Global defaults: every index and query engine uses these unless overridden
Settings.llm = Ollama(model="llama3.3", request_timeout=60.0, context_window=8000)
Settings.embed_model = HuggingFaceEmbedding(model_name="BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5")
```

The embedding model name is only an example. You need the `llama-index-llms-ollama` and `llama-index-embeddings-huggingface` packages installed, and Ollama running with the model pulled.

I don't know from these docs whether LlamaIndex falls back to OpenAI for any component you leave unset. To be sure OpenAI is never contacted, set both `Settings.llm` and `Settings.embed_model` explicitly, and check any other components (such as a reranker or response synthesizer) for a default that calls OpenAI.
